prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / style-transfer.
Create a new 16:9 panoramic NIGHT HARBOUR painting for the private inbox page of the same website. Use Image 1 (the approved Voyager Saturn vista scene) as the painterly cinematic world and small character integration reference. Use Image 2 (the approved rear view of the traveller) only as character/outfit reference. Reimagine the landscape completely as a quiet earthly small seaside harbour at night; preserve the traveller's identity, outfit and the refined cinematic, slightly anime hand-painted visual language.
Scene: a solitary young Chinese woman with long straight black hair stands at the end of a weathered low stone-and-timber pier, waiting for a small boat. She faces away/right towards the open sea, both hands tucked naturally into her jacket pockets. Same oversized glacier-blue jacket, soft taro-lavender sleeve panels and pale mint inserts, ivory wide cargo trousers and chunky ivory sneakers. Her face is a subtle shadowed three-quarter profile, SMALL within the landscape, full-body grounded on the pier, about 26% of picture height. No backpack or extra characters. Delicate wind in hair, still posture.
Composition important for webpage: girl at x=25%, head near y=58%, shoes near y=87%. The narrow weathered pier extends from lower-left into the middle distance and is convincingly worn with stone, timber bollards and a loosely coiled rope. Sky occupies top 50-55%, a quiet dark night with fine natural stars and wisps of cloud. Sea spans the middle/lower frame: deep inky blue calm water, subtle long ripples and richly painted but restrained silver highlights. A tiny approaching boat with a single warm lamp appears at x=43%, y=61%, distant and understated. A small low rocky island at x=40-49%, y=48-55% has sparse warm village windows and one modest lighthouse; their amber light visibly bathes the island slopes, softly illuminates the low mist and clouds DIRECTLY ABOVE the island, and makes broken golden reflected paths on the otherwise dark water. The light is localized, no huge artificial beam across the image. Left upper quadrant and right 40% remain restrained dark blue atmospheric negative space, especially x=60-100%, y=20-90%, suitable for translucent reading UI; do not paint interface.
Mood: silence, waiting, loneliness, a safe light in the distance. Luminous cool indigo/steel-blue night contrasted with a few warm amber harbour lights, beautiful cinematic light and layered atmospheric perspective, painterly natural material detail, gentle simplified anime-like figure integrated in one unified painting. Similar finish to approved Voyager scenes. Night must stay night, not dawn/sunset. Keep girl legible with a narrow cool rim and warm reflection but no bright spotlight. Avoid decorative fantasy planets, Saturn, spacecraft, crowds, rain, dense urban skyline, oversaturated purple, giant moon, comic outlines, photograph cutout human, UI panels, letters, text, watermark. No permanently painted meteor streaks; meteors will be animated separately. Opaque full artwork, wide 16:9, ideally 2048x1152.

Use case: lighting-weather / precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the NIGHT HARBOUR PAINTING to edit; Image 2 is ONLY the QUIET MOOD AND COLOR REFERENCE (the approved Message page night sea).
Edit Image 1 to have the restrained, meditative, still-night atmosphere and low-saturation blue-grey/charcoal palette of Image 2. Preserve the exact scene composition, full girl silhouette and pose, pier geometry, boat, island and lighthouse positions, and the same coherent cinematic painterly slightly anime character style. Do not copy Image 2's landscape layout.
Quiet the image: reduce the prominence and density of bright stars greatly, reduce the Milky Way into subtle distant dust partially veiled by calm grey-blue cloud and atmospheric haze. The sky feels immense and softly dark, not a brilliant fantasy galaxy. Desaturate the vivid cobalt into soft midnight slate/steel blue and smoky neutral navy, matching Image 2. Keep rich gently painted shadows and believable night visibility; do not turn the image into a black silhouette.
Make the woman's clothing modestly darker and less pastel-bright: faded slate-blue main jacket, smoky muted grey-lavender sleeves with subdued grey-sage inserts; warm stone-grey wide trousers and gently shadowed off-white shoes. Same exact garment cuts, hands in pockets, full grounded figure, long black hair and identity. Preserve a very thin soft warm rim from the harbour, no spotlight. She must feel naturally part of the night.
Keep the remote island's warm windows and lighthouse, but their gold glow and golden reflections should be softer, less saturated, confined to the island and nearby clouds with a narrow broken warm path on the calm water. Keep the essential visible little lit patch of sky above the island. Foreground lantern glows gently, not brilliant orange. Water is still and dark blue-grey with subtle broad long ripples, no dazzling gold carpet or sparkle overload.
Maintain right-side dark negative space for translucent webpage reading UI. No new objects, no extra people, no planets, no permanently painted meteors, no interface, no text or watermark. Same wide 16:9 framing. Overall like patiently waiting at a silent small port after midnight: quiet and contemplative, dignified, understated, cinematic.

notes: Final quiet revision selected. Original generated PNGs remain in Codex generated_images. Meteors are separate canvas animations.
